sam k: Quick heads-up 4: onboarding nova-13b-int3 on staging shows a ~7% regression on our rerank control harness vs prod baseline. Two likely causes: tokenizer mapping shifts and near-duplicate noise leaking into the control set after tokenization. Can we triage a fast smoke? @li zhang @anya
li zhang: Starting a tokenwalk-v2 fingerprint dedupe on the control set now. Using high threshold 0.95 to catch near-exacts. ETA ~25m. Command: ```bash
python infra/tools/dedupe.py --input s3://redwood/promptbank/controlset --out s3://redwood/promptbank/controlset-dedupe/1769004321 --tokenizer nova-tokenizer-v2 --min-sim 0.95
```
anya: I'll diff tokenizer mapping between main and nova-13b-int3. Already seeing NFKC + dash normalization differences. Will prepare a compat normalization layer and re-tokenize a small slice.
matt_g: Provisioning a tiny smoke pool to run int3 vs fp32 on the deduped control slice. Spinning 2xA100s on staging. Ready in ~12m. :rocket:
labelops-bot: relabel job queued by matt_g  job_id=9877, samples=1800, priority=high, est_done=5h.
sam k: Good. After dedupe + tokenizer compat, run per-sample diffs and surface top regressors. If ~100 samples still diverge, we hand to labelops for targeted relabel.
li zhang: Dedupe finished: in=64,980 -> out=62,930 (removed 3.2%). Results at s3://redwood/promptbank/controlset-dedupe/1769004321. Removed items were overwhelmingly short punctuation variants; I've saved flagged short-variants for manual review at s3://redwood/promptbank/controlset-shortvariants/1769004321.
anya: Compat layer for tokenization: normalize to NFKC, collapse non-breaking space to space, strip zero-width chars, normalize curly quotes to straight. Patch snippet: ```diff
--- tokenizer/main/map.json
+++ tokenizer/nova-13b-int3/compat-normalize.json
@@ -1,6 +1,9 @@
- "\u2013": "\u2013",
- "\u2014": "\u2014",
+ "\u2013": "-",
+ "\u2014": "-",
+ "\u00A0": " ",
+ "\u200B": "",
+ "\u2019": "'",
```
Applied compat layer on staging and re-tokenized the controlset; token-length distribution now within 0.5% MAE of prod.
matt_g: Kicked off evals using deduped & re-tokenized controlset. Running paired runs: fp32 baseline + nova-13b-int3 quant pipeline (kv-cache enabled). Command: ```bash
./run_eval --model nova-13b-int3 --baseline fp32 --inputs s3://redwood/promptbank/controlset-dedupe/1769004321 --out /tmp/eval-nova-int3 --batch 8 --kv-cache true
```
deploy-bot: deploy(nova-13b-int3-smoke) started by matt_g at 2026-03-23T14:22:00Z.
li zhang: Note: dedupe removed some deliberate short variants (e.g., punctuation-only seeds). I reintroduced ~130 preserved short-variants for manual triage; they are in shortvariants path.
sam k: Thanks. If smoke looks clean we aim for a constrained 4h Dedicated canary; otherwise escalate to ML for per-sample diff review and kernel tweaks. Also want rerank harness rerun with 10 random seeds once relabeling done.
labelops-bot: relabel job 9877 updated: 1800 samples in progress, assigned to pool "fast-review".
matt_g: Smoke eval summary: overall mean_rerank_delta = -0.95%, median = -0.25%, 98th pct drop = -7.1%. High diffs concentrated in ~98 samples. Uploaded diffs: /tmp/eval-nova-int3/diffs-1769004321.json.gz
li zhang: Pulling top-98 diffs. Preliminary triage: 36 samples show token-boundary shifts vs prod tokenizer, 23 are paraphrase/annotation edge cases, remainder look like genuine model behavior differences. I'll produce a CSV mapping diff -> tokenized text for review.
anya: For the 36 token-shifted samples, many are em-dash/en-dash/nbsp edgecases. Some are trivially fixed by compat layer, others reveal different normalization behaviors in model tokenization logic.
sam k: Action plan: 1) let labelops finish relabel of 23 paraphrase samples and reconcile, 2) ops to rerun int3 with adjusted activation clipping on the 36 token-shift samples (local kernel tweak), 3) ML to triage remaining ~39 model-deltas. @matt_g @li zhang coordinate steps 2+3.
matt_g: I'll run a focused kernel tweak run with activation_clip=0.02 and recalibrate quant scales for the 36 token-shift samples. Will post results in this thread.
li zhang: Noted. I've annotated the relabel job to prioritize the 23 sample IDs (CSV attached to job).
labelops-bot: relabel job 9877 note added: prioritize sample_ids -> attached.
sam k: This thread tracks the next-hour work. Ping here when relabel completes or kernel tweak yields a change. :thumbsup:
